annotation.title_clean: Secure Software Development Practices for Generative AI and Dual-Use Foundation Models: An SSDF Community Profile
annotation.title_en: Secure Software Development Practices for Generative AI and Dual-Use Foundation Models: An SSDF Community Profile
annotation.authors_or_issuer: National Institute of Standards and Technology (Booth, H.; Souppaya, M.; Vassilev, A.; Ogata, M.; Stanley, M.; Scarfone, K.)
annotation.summary_en: NIST SP 800-218A is an SSDF Community Profile, issued in response to EO 14110, that augments SSDF 1.1 with practices, recommendations and informative references for secure development of generative AI and dual-use foundation models, aimed at model producers, system producers and acquirers.
key_provisions_or_claims: Augments SSDF 1.1 practices and tasks with AI-model-specific recommendations, considerations and notes
Protect training pipelines, model registries and datasets with least privilege and separated environments
Consider human-in-the-loop review for security checks beyond risk thresholds
Maps to NIST AI RMF and OWASP LLM risks as informative references
Voluntary guidance for AI model producers, AI system producers and acquirers
